attributes.context: The preceding sentence specifies the current Food Service Production Center line maximums: cold food line at a maximum of 96 meals per minute and hot food line at 120 to 140 meals per minute, depending on product.

extraction_text: These maximums will not be intentionally increased unless improved equipment or changed product make an increase feasible and unless any anticipated increase is first discussed with representatives of the affected employees.

attributes.context: The provision appears in a layoff-related section that also addresses layoff criteria for classified and instructional assistant employees, reinstatement rights after layoff, and a restriction on hiring new instructional assistants while instructional assistants are on layoff.

extraction_text: In the event the placing in a school cafeteria of vending machines or automatic dispensing machines results in a reduction in the required personnel or their hours, the affected personnel shall not be reduced in classification or number of scheduled hours prior to being offered reassignment to a position with the same classification and number of scheduled hours except that such personnel may be assigned duties (no reduction in pay) related to a lower classification prior to being offered said reassignment position. Such offered position shall be the vacancy after the first posting.

attributes.context: This appears in Section 11.8 Work Groups/TQE, where the parties also commit to efficient and economical customer service and provide limited funding for recommendations that lead to cost savings or improved customer service.

extraction_text: To that end they agree to encourage work groups and teams to study and make recommendations regarding the improvement of work processes.

attributes.context: The TQE process is described in the same section as involving work groups and teams that study and recommend improvements to work processes, with successful recommendations potentially leading to cost savings or improved customer service.

extraction_text: No employee will lose his/her job as a result of any suggestions made during the TQE process or the implementation of those suggestions.
